page.overview:
Who is Tartarus?

Tartarus (Ταρταρος) was the personification of Tartarus.

Tartarus was a powerful and greatly feared Protogenoi Deity.

He was born from Chaos with Gaea, Aether, Eros, Erebos, and Nyx.

After Uranus died, Gaea and Tartarus had a child. Their child was Typhon, the storm spirit. Gaea sent Typhon to destroy Zeus but he was defeated and imprisoned under Mt. Etna
